description: This file defines a React functional component 'Arc' that renders an animated elliptical arc SVG with gradient stroke and customizable properties like progress, rotation, and colors. It includes utility functions and hooks for dynamic behavior, such as generating a unique gradient ID and calculating arc length.

methods.name: getCircumferenceOfArc
methods.description: Calculates the circumference of an elliptical arc based on radii rx and ry.
